audit.whatIsWrong: Rated HARD 8/10 on a 50.6% win rate over 664 games, and the full-layer chart gave Diana 6 of 7 stages while the packet and the content layer both give her 5 and hand the last two to Aurelion Sol.
audit.why: Diana genuinely owns levels 1-5: Crescent Strike is 900 range and Lunar Rush onto a marked target costs no cooldown at all. But Moonfall reaches only 475, against a 750 Q and a 1250 Falling Star, so once Rod of Ages lands the range gap decides it. 50.6% is even, not hard.
audit.corrected: diff TRICKY, diffRating 6/10, tone #ff8b3d (the token this repo uses for TRICKY on brand and cassiopeia); chart Diana x5 / Aurelion Sol / Aurelion Sol on both layers.
sources: packet winRate 50.6 over 664 games and its levelChart

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] and content late build Shadowflame/Stormsurge; the full layer's itemization builds Rod of Ages, Archangel's, Liandry's, Rabadon's.
audit.why: Two different builds on one page. report[8] is the stated build.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text, late, breakdown.mid and breakdown.spikes realigned to Rod of Ages and Archangel's, with the level-6 spike expressed as 1250 range against her 475.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Lunar Rush mechanic was stated wrongly in four places. spikes[1] says 'Lunar Rush resets on any takedown'; wants.foe[2] says 'resetting Lunar Rush'; content mid says 'reset off a kill'; spikes[0] says she 'closes the gap with Moonfall'.
audit.why: enemyKit E: 'Lunar Rush has no cooldown when used to dash to an enemy afflicted with Moonlight.' It is a Moonlight condition, not a takedown reset. And Moonfall is the 475-range pull, not the gap-closer — Lunar Rush (825) is.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten to the real rule: Crescent Strike marks for 3s, and only a marked target makes the dash free; otherwise Lunar Rush is 22s at rank 1, 14s at rank 5.
sources: enemyKit Q, E and R text

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page said that Moonfall's draw-in ends an Aurelion Sol channel, or that Moonfall only reaches 475.
audit.why: ownerKit Q and W both carry the channel flag ('interruptible — any CC cancels it'). Moonfall draws enemies in, which takes the beam off target and ends the flight. Its 475 range is also the single biggest reason this matchup flips: she must be inside 475 to use her ultimate at all.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[0].d, spikes[1].text, mid, breakdown.carry and breakdown.late now state both.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Voice of Light' used as an Aurelion Sol ability in spikes[3] and content late.
audit.why: Not in the kit — the abilities are Breath of Light (Q), Astral Flight (W), the black hole (E), Falling Star / The Skies Descend (R).
audit.corrected: Replaced with Breath of Light and Falling Star.

audit.whatIsWrong: PRONOUNS — Diana is female and 14 fields called her he/his: tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, phases[1].why, phases[3].why, phases[4].why, breakdown.wave, dosFull[2].t, dontsFull[0].t, dontsFull[2].t, report[0].t, report[1].t, report[4].t, report[11].t.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists diana as female; the owner is addressed as 'you', so every third-person pronoun refers to her.
It is the field that carries real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Crescent Strike 8s at rank 1 / 6s at rank 5, Lunar Rush 22s (free onto Moonlight), Pale Cascade 15s at rank 1, Moonfall 475 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were copy-paste bleed — tradeGood and tradeBad pasted under 'Hold Flash + R as a paired dive answer' and 'Contest his shove pre-item spike'.
audit.why: The titles promise the R/Flash dive answer and the shove-contest rule; the bodies explained the W flyby and the Q channel.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to match their titles.

notes: The tone edit here (#ff5d6c -> #ff8b3d) is inferred, not documented: brand and cassiopeia both carry diff TRICKY with tone #ff8b3d, and this page carried diff HARD with #ff5d6c, so the two fields track each other. If that inference is wrong, revert the tone edit only — the diff and diffRating edits stand on the 50.6% win rate. The packet's three suspectNames on this matchup are false positives as NAMES (Crescent Strike and Pale Cascade are both correct), but the sentences containing them were mechanically wrong for a different reason and have been rewritten anyway. Full and content charts disagreed on rows 5 and 6 before this edit; both now read Diana x5 / Aurelion Sol / Aurelion Sol, matching the packet.
